iterations.name: fuse the per-vertex fetch into the generated vertex shader (same-LLVM bitcode inline)
iterations.note: cp_vertex_fetch's per-lane gather is linked into the generated vertex shader as NVPTX bitcode in the same LLVMContext and force-inlined before optimisation (the iteration-14 fragment-interpolation machinery, generalised); the attributes land in a function-entry alloca SROA promotes to registers, so the packed input buffer, its clear, its round trip, the id arrays and the batch-row array all cease to exist for an admitted shader. THE SHAPE OF THE EMITTED CALL IS THE WHOLE MECHANISM: a loop over the elements bounded by a constant N and marked unroll(full) was REFUSED by LLVM's unroller for every real capture shader (size heuristic), the slot array was then indexed dynamically, and a dynamically indexed alloca is local memory -- launch-weighted admission A=0.1081 in that form. Emitting the unrolled sequence from the backend, one cp_vs_fetch_element call per LIVE slot with the element index an LLVMConstInt, gives A=0.9538 on old and A=0.8838 on Crossroads with no .local anywhere; the only decline reason that occurs is losing a block per SM (9 shaders/14228 launches on old), never a surviving helper or spill. Two smaller rules: never write a slot as bytes in one path and words in another (SROA refuses that partition), and bound inner loops with continue not break. New per-shader vertex LAUNCH census (nothing recorded one before) is what makes A launch-weighted rather than shader-weighted. Iteration 26 S2's counter seeding moves into the fused kernel with the launch it rode on; CUDAVK_VFETCH_SKIP_SEED is the negative control and makes 3 existing tests fail. Default vs CUDAVK_NO_FUSED_VFETCH (which does not even build the second binary), one session, AB/BA, identical stdout hashes: old 16.5013 -> 15.9726 (+0.5287, +3.20%), Crossroads 6.0758 -> 5.9831 (+0.0927, +1.53%). DECISIVE MEASUREMENT, six runs per arm strictly alternating in one session: default median 16.0194 (IQR 15.9987-16.0343, four of six runs at or above 16.0) against reverted 16.5119 (IQR 16.5032-16.5456), delta of medians +0.4925 (+2.98%), paired deltas +0.4424 to +0.6203 median +0.5027; Crossroads four per arm 5.9928 vs 6.0715, +0.0787 (+1.30%). THE DEFAULT ARM'S IQR STRADDLES 16.0: the goal is reached AT THE LINE and not safely, so quote 16.02 and the delta, not 15.97. Per frame on old: -194.3 fetch launches, -194.3 clears, -84.9 MB of clear traffic, -192.0 host-to-device copies. PRICE CORRECTION: the design assumed 1.4-2.2us per removed same-stream launch and predicted 0.62ms at this admission; holding iteration 26's prices for the removed clears (0.66us) and merged copies (0.59us) fixed leaves UNDER 1us per launch, so take 0.6-1.0us -- iteration 3's higher figure included device-work reduction this fusion does not have. Consequence: iteration 25's A-buffer support-chain candidate drops from 0.3-0.6ms to ~0.11-0.18ms. Sweep hot sum 25.28 -> 22.59 (-10.6%), instancing 4.54 -> 2.06 (the rock shader goes 120 -> 104 registers at equal occupancy, so iteration 4's blowup does not reproduce); pbribl regresses 0.03ms on a 0.5ms frame, a literal miss of the design's criterion 6, kept deliberately -- an arm that builds and measures the fused binary but forces every shader to decline matches the reverted arm, so the cost is in fused execution on that workload and not in the infrastructure. Gates: suite 65/65 default and reverted (4 new cpvk_vfetch modes + 2 gates, covering formats, sparse locations, divisor and mixed decline, all passing on llvmpipe too); six batch reproducers byte-identical across five batching modes x default/reverted; Crossroads sentinels byte-identical to the iteration-24 frozen reference; old sentinels within the recorded run-to-run class; stored60 reproduces iteration 24's NVIDIA verdict with its two standing exceptions. Driver gap found while writing the divisor test: VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_INSTANCE maps to divisor 1 and VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor is not implemented, so a divisor above one is unreachable through the API (CUDAVK_HANDOFF.md gap 17).

iterations.name: fuse the A-buffer support chain into two static per-episode passes
iterations.note: Two static per-episode fusions of the A-buffer support chain, no persistent kernel and no host sync added. S1 collapses the prefix scan from 5 launches (3 on the small scan) to 2: one shared tiling ept=max(1,ceil(n/(512*512))) keeps grid<=512 by construction, scan_reduce writes block sums, scan_finish redundantly scans the <=512 block sums in shared memory so every block gets its own base AND the grand total without waiting on another block, traffic 2n reads+2n writes -> 2n reads+n writes. S2 collapses the quad chain from 6 launches + a 0.9 MB clear to 3: quad_count_all replaces block_worklist+quad_count on the S1 tiling, tests coverage itself, WRITES 0 when uncovered (retiring the clear) and block-reduces its own counts (retiring that scan's reduce); quad_fill_all skips blk_counts[b]==0 and blk_list disappears. Per episode 15 launches + 2 large clears become 9 launches and none. MEASURED, two independent sessions of a four-arm alternating harness, palindromic arm order, equivalence gate provably unset in all 16 runs, identical stdout hashes: old 15.9696 -> 15.7488 (+0.2208, +1.38%, 6.3 sigma), Crossroads 5.9685 -> 5.8777 (+0.0907, +1.52%, 6.8 sigma); old reproduced to 0.003 ms across sessions and the verdict does not depend on which arm carries the flag. SEPARATE HALVES: S1 alone did NOT resolve on old (+0.094 one session, -0.020 the other, 1.1 sigma); S2 alone paid (+0.105 both sessions). Together +0.221 > the +0.142 the halves sum to, while removing FEWER launches than the halves sum to (91.1 vs 59.6+47.3, they overlap on the block scan) - the value is in making the episode chain short and static, not in either fusion, and per-fusion forecasts are not additive. PRICE CORRECTION: 0.2208 ms over 118.5 removed device ops is 1.86 us each, about twice iteration 27's sub-1-us same-stream launch price, because the clears also carried 49.9 MB/frame and the compaction pass over 230,400 blocks stopped running. Removals/frame: old 1405.4 -> 1314.2 launches (-91.1) and 262.8 -> 235.4 clears (-27.4); Crossroads -50.1 and -16.1. GATES: device-side equivalence of classic vs fused over the WHOLE replay of both captures (23,814 scans + 23,814 quad builds on old, 13,310 + 13,310 on Crossroads, all four difference counters zero, re-run zero at the shipping default); blk_counts coverage PROVED by sentinel pre-fill (0 never-written entries over the replay, while BREAK=2 reports 1,691,296); the fused grand total is bit-identical by construction because the reassociation is over uint32 counts, so the gate compares with != and not an epsilon; both negative controls fail the gate AND destroy the image (BREAK=1 60,208,448 differing elements, 60.5 mean channel error, 440,741 pixels over 32 against an envelope of at most 1,815, then device loss; BREAK=2 device loss before the first sentinel frame); suite 65/65 fused and 65/65 with both reverts; Crossroads sentinels byte-identical 9/9; old sentinels inside the llvmpipe envelope on all ten frames; 18-sample sweep run at the default AND with both reverts shows only the two standing exceptions, identical in both builds. STANDING DEFAULT AS A DISTRIBUTION (six runs old, four Crossroads, no arms): old median 15.7514, IQR [15.7305, 15.7596], full range [15.7200, 15.7911]; Crossroads median 5.8982. The IQR and the whole range sit under 16.0, so the objective is met with 0.21 ms of margin at the worst observed run rather than at the median. 60-frame visual pass and 600-frame sweep re-run at this HEAD with the native ICD and recorded through the Gallium-era iteration reporter, so the frames can be inspected: ~/git/Vulkan/build/iter/iter28-native/ holds 60 PNGs per sample for 17 samples, verdict.txt (only the two standing exceptions: gltfscenerendering pre-existing REGRESSED and renderheadless missing) and bench/_bench.csv summing 16.03 ms; the gallery pages at ~/git/Vulkan/build/iter/{iterations.json,iterations.html,perf.html} were regenerated and now carry this iteration.
